matching_rules.guard_precedence: GUARD_ templates (id starting with GUARD_) have absolute precedence over any answer template. When matched, they escalate immediately with response: null to prevent unverified brand statements.
matching_rules.how_it_works: Each template has 'triggers' (keywords/phrases). If a customer message contains ANY trigger from a template's list, that template fires. If multiple templates match, the one with the MOST matched keywords wins. If nothing matches confidently, escalate to human — never guess.
matching_rules.matching_type: case-insensitive substring / fuzzy keyword match (no LLM reasoning, no semantic guessing)
matching_rules.min_confidence: At least 1 strong keyword match required. Generic words alone (e.g. 'price', 'have') should NOT fire a template without a product keyword alongside them.

templates.response:
Hi, thank you for getting in touch.

I would have loved to. However, the Norom Pak Sondesh that we make can be transported from one city to another only through a reliable cold-chain courier service. Unfortunately, we haven't yet found a partner who can offer this at a reasonable cost.

So for now, we're unable to ship our sondesh outside Delhi NCR — we do not deliver to Bangalore or other cities at this time. We'd love to, though, and will certainly start as soon as we find a dependable cold-chain delivery option.

That said, many of our regular customers who live in different parts of India and the world do buy our sondesh by asking friends or family travelling from Delhi NCR to carry a few boxes for them. We're happy to deliver the order to their home, office, hotel, or any other convenient location before they travel.

Thank you for thinking of camellia.artisanal!

What sets Camellia Artisanal apart from commercial sweet shops:

• *Pure Ingredients*: We use 100% pure dairy and unadulterated desi A2 cow milk (never milk powder or commercial stabilizers).
• *Real Kolkata Nolen Gur*: Our liquid Nolen Gur is sourced directly from artisanal jaggery producers in Bengal — zero chemical essences or artificial coloring.
• *Made Fresh to Order*: Every single Sondesh is handcrafted from scratch in small batches by our all-women kitchen team in Sushant Lok, Gurgaon, with subtle natural sweetness.
• *Eco-Friendly & Pure*: Delivered in plastic-free, cornstarch-based boxes.

Over the past two months, we have personally run our Gurgaon kitchen to ensure every aspect of the operation met the standards we had envisioned.

Today, we have a professional team in place, led by our Kitchen Manager, Guru Dayal Singh (camellia.artisanal.gurgaon@gmail.com). Our women kitchen team has been with us for the past four years and has been extensively trained by us. Together, they now run the kitchen through well-established systems, processes, quality checks and balances.

Over the last few weeks, we have deliberately reduced our physical presence in the kitchen and have been monitoring operations remotely. The transition has gone exactly as planned, and the kitchen is now operating independently while consistently maintaining our standards.

This gives us the confidence to move to Kolkata, knowing that nothing changes for our guests in Delhi NCR. The same kitchen, the same team, the same recipes, the same ingredients, and the same goal of trying to be at uncompromising standards will continue — exactly as they do today.
